messages.subject: Offsite venue + handover before leave
messages.body: Hi Maya, quick handover before I'm off (back 2 Nov, no email). Offsite: went with the Harbor Room at Pier 9 Events, Friday 16 Oct, 9:00-17:00, room for 12, AV and lunch included, $1,400. Ref HR-2207. They put a hold on it for us and need the 30% deposit by Fri 9 Oct to lock it in, I'll sort that Monday before I go. Team for the invite: Priya, Lucia, Jonas, Amara, you and me (I'll miss it, obviously). Parking is in the Pier 9 lot, entrance on the Embarcadero side. Signage invoice went to Dana on the 1st. Tomas
